ratios.quote: At December 31, 2025, our leverage ratio was 1.77 to 1.0, which meets the requirement of not being above 3 to 1.

parsed.notes: The same covenant is disclosed in both MD&A and the debt note, with identical figures; it is reported once. The filing does not say whether the leverage ratio is total or net, so total_leverage is an assumption. The 1.77 leverage ratio mentioned in the overview bullet is the same figure. The leverage-based grids for applicable margin and fees are excluded.
